subfigures.description: One diagram, not multiple panels. A concave arcuate mirror stands near the right, bows rightward at the horizontal axis, and has short diagonal hatching on its right/back side. No given numeric measures or coordinate ticks.

items.pixels: Solid, nearly horizontal line from the left edge through O, an open-circle F, mirror pole P, and an open-circle S with small subscript 1 near the right edge. Left-to-right order is O, F, P, S_1. No axis arrowhead is apparent.
Dashed vertical line through F, extending from the top edge to below the principal axis. Vertical Chinese text to its right reads focal plane. The line intersects two oblique lines above F at D.

A is at the lower-left end of a solid rising-right line that reaches the mirror at C above P. A filled arrow on that segment points from A toward C. S_1 is not on this incident segment or its straight continuation.

Solid line from mirror C through D and farther toward the upper left. A filled arrow near its upper-left end points away from C toward the upper left. The same straight line extends rightward from C with a short solid segment followed by dashed segments to S_1. Thus S_1 is on the backward extension of CD, not on AC.
Solid rising-right line from near the lower-left edge through O and D, ending in the upper-middle area left of the mirror. It is visually parallel to AC. There is no obvious arrowhead on OD.
D is the common intersection of the dashed focal plane, rising-right OD, and falling-right DC. It is above F and left of C, with the D label to its lower left.

Visible Latin/math labels are A, O, F, D, C, P, S_1. F and S_1 have open circular marks; O, D, and C lie on line intersections or line ends. A is labeled below the incident segment; O above/left of its principal-axis crossing; F above/left of the open focal mark; C above/left of its mirror crossing; P below/left of the pole; S_1 below the right open mark. No additional clear labeled point.
